items.title: A total pointwise product for extended-real-valued functions
items.statement: For any set X and functions f,g:X→Rbar, define f⊙_Xg:X→Rbar by the zero rule, the real product on finite nonzero values, and the sign rule when both values are nonzero and at least one is infinite. The operation is total on all functions; it does not assert measurability or alter the partial scalar product.

references.title: Sheldon Axler, Measure, Integration and Real Analysis, Section 3A
John K. Hunter, Measure Theory, Section 3.2

items.title: Zero, sign, and finite cases for the pointwise function product
items.statement: On a ten-point set, calculate the function-level product for all four zero-infinity pairs, all four sign combinations of a nonzero infinite value with a nonzero finite value, and two finite pairs.
